sources.summary: OpenAI expects AI to become a major issue in the 2028 presidential election and is preparing a policy and public relations push after the U.S. midterm elections. The company is also promoting the term “AI compute campuses” for its data centers as it seeks to address concerns over electricity demand, water consumption, pollution and rising utility bills

stories.title: Nvidia Brev security breach may have exposed SSH keys used to access customer VMs — investigation finds unauthorized activity spanning 16 days, but no evidence of misuse

sources.title: Nvidia Brev security breach may have exposed SSH keys used to access customer VMs — investigation finds unauthorized activity spanning 16 days, but no evidence of misuse
sources.title_en: Nvidia Brev security breach may have exposed SSH keys used to access customer VMs — investigation finds unauthorized activity spanning 16 days, but no evidence of misuse
sources.title_original: Nvidia Brev security breach may have exposed SSH keys used to access customer VMs — investigation finds unauthorized activity spanning 16 days, but no evidence of misuse
sources.summary: Nvidia is investigating a security incident involving its Brev cloud development platform after detecting unauthorized activity between October 4 and October 20. The incident may have exposed SSH keys used to access customer virtual machines. Nvidia has rotated the affected keys and updated customer instances, but says it is unaware of any improper use
sources.summary_zh: 在检测到 10 月 4 日至 20 日期间未经授权的活动后，Nvidia 正在调查涉及其 Brev 云开发平台的安全事件。该事件可能暴露了用于访问客户虚拟机的 SSH 密钥。 Nvidia 已轮换受影响的密钥并更新了客户实例，但表示尚未发现任何不当使用情况

stories.title: 索尼最后一款4K蓝光播放器在日本上市缺货，公司或准备放弃独立播放器 / Sony's final 4K Blu-ray player listed as out of stock in Japan, firm may be preparing to abandon standalone players

sources.title: 索尼最后一款4K蓝光播放器在日本上市缺货，公司或准备放弃独立播放器 / Sony's final 4K Blu-ray player listed as out of stock in Japan, firm may be preparing to abandon standalone players
sources.title_zh: 索尼最后一款4K蓝光播放器在日本上市缺货，公司或准备放弃独立播放器
sources.title_en: Sony's final 4K Blu-ray player listed as out of stock in Japan, firm may be preparing to abandon standalone players
sources.title_original: Sony's final 4K Blu-ray player listed as out of stock in Japan, firm may be preparing to abandon standalone players
sources.summary: Sony may be preparing to abandon the standalone 4K Blu-ray player market after retailers in Japan reportedly stopped expecting new shipments of its final remaining model, the UBP-X700K. The company has not confirmed a worldwide withdrawal, and the player remains listed in the U.S. However, Sony's retreat from other physical media products, alongside exits by Oppo, Samsung, LG, and Reavon, raises further questions about the future of dedicated disc players.
sources.summary_zh: 据报道，日本零售商不再期待其最后一款型号 UBP-X700K 的新出货量，索尼可能正准备放弃独立 4K 蓝光播放器市场。该公司尚未确认在全球范围内退出，该播放器仍在美国上市。然而，索尼退出其他物理媒体产品，加上 Oppo、三星、LG 和 Reavon 的退出，引发了人们对专用光盘播放器未来的进一步质疑。
